desc:
[PLAY WITH GRAPHICS 6+ FOR A BETTER EXPERIENCE]

Yeah, another animation game.

Watch animations starring your own avatar, pick your friends to join the cast, or create your own animations and share them with the community.

This started as a small solo project for testing animations, but I'll keep adding more over time whenever I have new ideas.

The goal isn't to be completely different from every other animation game. I just want to add animations that you probably won't find in most of them, like the Lucid Paradise or the Tuff Irida.

- If you find any bugs, missing assets, or broken animations, please let me know in the game server.
- If you have a problem with something that I'm using in my game, please contact me in my server.
